steps.action: Without using any tools, what is your best estimate of the current date and time?

I don’t have a clock or calendar, so the best I can do is make an educated guess based on the fact that the model was most recently updated in mid-2024 and that people often ask “What’s the date?” shortly after a release. If I assume only a modest amount of time has passed, I’d place us in early 2025. So my rough, tool-free estimate:

Sometime in February 2025, perhaps around mid-month—say 14 February 2025—and, if pressed for a time, somewhere in the afternoon UTC.
